parameters.query:
WITH week_activities AS (
    SELECT sport_type, SUM(CAST(summary_metrics->>'distance_m' AS NUMERIC)) as total_dist, SUM(CAST(summary_metrics->>'time_s' AS NUMERIC)) as total_time
    FROM activities 
    WHERE athlete_id = '{{ $json.id }}' AND start_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
    GROUP BY sport_type
),
current_strategy AS (
    SELECT * FROM strategy_phases WHERE goal_id IN (SELECT id FROM goals WHERE athlete_id = '{{ $json.id }}' AND status = 'Active') 
    AND end_date >= CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(wa.*)) FROM week_activities wa) as week_volume,
    (SELECT row_to_json(cs.*) FROM current_strategy cs) as strategy,
    coach_notes,
    telegram_id
FROM athletes WHERE id = '{{ $json.id }}';
